description:
Two new entertainment experiences opened in New York, allowing visitors to step inside a popular holiday movie and a timeless board game.
 
Hasbro has turned the classic board game "Candy Land," which first launched in 1949, into an interactive retail space with specialty items. And Warner Bros is inviting people to step inside the world of the classic holiday film "Elf," starring Will Ferrell. Alicia Powell walks us through.

author: Reuters
description:
On this week’s episode of On Assignment, host Jonah Green speaks with Reuters correspondent John Davison about Under Fire, a graphic memoir by Reuters that tells the story of one Iranian woman through a year of protests, war and a tenuous ceasefire. Davison describes how he reported it over 11 months, how the team verified meticulous details with illustrator Adolfo Arranz, and what daily life looked like inside Iran during the conflict.
